author: imaNoah
body:
Application
Age: 13 (turning 14 this year)
Timezone: Pacific Time Zone
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes if you wanna add me supernoah6666
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF-REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? : Yes, I've been a Mod on a Faction server but then the server dies down since the owner couldn't take any more stress.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? : The weakness is probably if I'm not having a good day or I'm just sick because If I don't feel like playing MC because I feel kind of sick or if I'm not having a good day I will just get of Minecraft. My biggest strength has to be being active if anybody needs help and there's no staff I will just help them if there's a hacker tho I would just take a video or contact a staff.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? : I think  I will improve the staff team because I'm very active and I will help anybody in need and if someone did /report (Name) I would go and spectate that guy/girl and see if there cheating.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? : Well a leader needs to at least have this quality; Patients, Leadership, Sportsmanship, and Confidence and more. I don't think I consider myself as a leader because I'm not patient for example, I ordered a speed cube online (A Rubik cube) and I've been waiting for about 5 days now, I'm still waiting for it and I'm not patient! I keep asking my dad "when is it my speed cube coming home" he says to be patient.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? : Well, I'm very active in a way since my school has some after school club that I go to on Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Every day except for Monday, Wednesday I will be active and if someone needs help I'm the guy who will help.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? : Well the skills for interacting with the community are; Clear voice, Can fluently speak Spanish/English (or any other languages but mostly English) and I think that's it. I think I have these skills except for the fact I can't speak Spanish.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 5 hours for being a staff and 4 hours of being a player like playing games and scrims.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? : I would record the video post it on youtube and let the staff deal with it because after all I'm a junior moderator I don't have perms to /ban or /freeze I believe. If no staff are available to watch the video I would just contact one on discord/skype/TeamSpeak


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? : I would just move him to my teamspeak so he can't talk to his teammates that he is harrasing and we would just talk so he will forget about harrassing him and he will focus on the game with me, we will also just talk about some staff stuff if he doesn't wanna play. 


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? : I would Either SS him or ask a higher staff if he should be ban or not, if they say he is unbanned  I would watch him and record it and see if he's hacking or not.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? : I would ask "Why can't people who are not on the staff team see it?" because everybody has the right to see it and besides if you wanna send something that no players can't see send it to the discord chat.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? : Well, there a higher rank them me I would listen to them because if I didn't it would be disrespectful, but I have the right to choose my own desicion, but it would be disrespctful so therefore I will listen to them.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? : It would mean a lot, right now this is my current favourite server and If I become mod on my favourite server I would legit dance in front on my parents.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? : Well, avicus is not a server to me, it's a community, a community where people can share what they did at school. When my friends start to fight I just go on avicus, all my friends hack execpt for me, I only hack on geomotry dash and more but not in MC, if I tell them the IP They will hack so I just say this is my secret server. If avicus was a real person I would be best friends with him.


Do you speak any other languages than English? Yes, I speak English, Korean (I can understand Japanese)


Do you have anything else to add to your application? Well to know me a little bit better. Hi my name is Noah I live in Canada VA and Im 13 years old (Turning 14 this year) I would like to say thank you for reading my appilcation, If I don't get in that will be fine, even thoguh I had to restart because I accedently did Command Q and it quited but thats alright. Things I do when i'm not playing MC are; LoL (League of Legends) CR (Clash Royale) Instagram, Twitter, Speed cubing a Skewb or square 1 (Search it up is a type of Rubik cube) and I just walk outside to my park when im bored! Have a nice day!!


-Noah
